nodes.label: Sera Voss
nodes.description: Dawnborn; already willing to sacrifice herself; players meet her in Session 1; used to make players love the hope before the cost lands

nodes.label: Lira Anwick
nodes.description: Dawnborn; has a three-year-old daughter; refuses the ritual; her consent is the hardest to earn for the Inversion ending

nodes.label: Tomas Areth
nodes.description: Dawnborn; surge-phase; has done the math and is writing his will; proposes the asymmetry alternative path

nodes.label: Theron Waide
nodes.description: Archivist who found the truth eleven years ago and said nothing out of guilt; his confession is a key Session 2 gut-punch

nodes.label: Brother Edoran
nodes.description: Leader of the Restorers; lost daughter to grey sickness; grief organized into theological certainty; partly right, which makes disagreement harder

nodes.label: Commander Harran
nodes.description: The Reckoning's leader; pragmatic authoritarian; believes city survival overrides Dawnborn consent; catalyst antagonist

nodes.label: Chancellor Mira Ostenveld
nodes.description: Chose strategic ignorance; doesn't want to know the cost; mirrors players' own Session 1 choice to take the job before asking what it is

nodes.label: Isolde Menth
nodes.description: Scholar; inventor of the Transfer Method alternative path; science-based approach with 15-20% chance of Dawnborn death

nodes.label: Ysel Maren
nodes.description: Dawnborn ensemble; told Edoran yes months before players arrived; waiting for someone to verify her consent was genuinely free

nodes.label: Cormac Drell
nodes.description: Dawnborn ensemble; said yes nine weeks ago and isn't sure he means it anymore

nodes.label: Erem
nodes.description: Supporting NPC; appears in AI tools deep prompts for offline NPC chat

nodes.label: OGAS NPC Format
nodes.description: Occupation, Goal, Attitude, Secret — standard format for all NPCs in this campaign

nodes.label: NPCs Document
nodes.description: All NPCs in OGAS format; 10 Dawnborn, 8 supporting NPCs; relationship web table; skill gates
